metadata.description: Boss Skills Repo and Lab for my personal Claude Code configs and skills

plugins.name: twitter-tools
plugins.description: Twitter/X social media tools for downloading media and converting tweets to Instagram Reels format. Includes gallery-dl integration for media downloads and video composition tools for vertical content creation.

plugins.name: agent-harness
plugins.description: Agent harness tooling for Claude Code: subagents, commands, hooks, skills, and scripts that build and operate agentic dev workflows.

plugins.name: python-dev
plugins.description: Python development tooling for Claude Code: debug GitHub Actions CI failures end-to-end and ship changes via conventional-commit PRs. Assumes a uv-based project with ruff, ty, deptry, pre-commit, and mkdocs.

plugins.name: basedpyright-lsp
plugins.description: LSP plugin wiring up basedpyright-langserver for Python real-time diagnostics, hover docs, go-to-definition, and find-references in Claude Code. Requires basedpyright installed separately (`uv tool install basedpyright` or `pip install basedpyright`).

plugins.name: proxmox-infra
plugins.description: Homelab Proxmox VE tooling for Claude Code: skills for managing nodes, VMs, LXC containers, storage, and networking via the proxmoxer Python library, Ansible community.general.proxmox modules, and Terraform/OpenTofu Telmate provider.
